groqApiKey.label: Groq API key
groqApiKey.helpText: From https://console.groq.com/keys. Used for query normalization, reranking and answer generation.

dryRun.label: Dry run
dryRun.helpText: Log the reply the bot would post without posting it. Leave this ON until you have read a few runs.

autoReplyUnflaired.label: Answer unflaired posts
autoReplyUnflaired.helpText: Off means only posts flaired Ask, Question, Admissions or Doubt are answered.

minConfidence.label: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.helpText: Reranked top score a post must clear before the bot replies. Raise this if it is too chatty.

maxPostAgeMinutes.label: Max post age (minutes)
maxPostAgeMinutes.helpText: Never touch anything older than this.
